exercises.q: The witnesses appeared before the judge.
exercises.why: **предстали** — предста́ть (perfective): to appear (before). Wiktionary: пред- + стать.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Tom is due to be arraigned on October 20th.
exercises.why: **предстать** — предста́ть (perfective): to appear (before). Wiktionary: пред- + стать.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **отстают** — отстава́ть (imperfective): to fall behind, to lag (to be below average in performance); to be slow (of a clock); to be backward / behind; to be retarded; to come / fall off, to peel off. Wiktionary: отста́ть + -ва́ть.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to revolt, to rise, to rebel
to fall behind, to lag (to be below average in performance)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: восста́ть — to revolt, to rise, to rebel; предста́ть — to appear (before); отстава́ть — to fall behind, to lag (to be below average in performance); привста́ть — to half-rise.

**отстают** — отстава́ть (imperfective): to fall behind, to lag (to be below average in performance); to be slow (of a clock); to be backward / behind; to be retarded; to come / fall off, to peel off. Wiktionary: отста́ть + -ва́ть.
